adapted.prompt: Brief reasoning followed by Final answer: LETTER
adapted.metric: micro exact letter accuracy, invalid answers incorrect
adapted.first_token_caveat: First prediction is prefill. Report first-prediction-only completions and actual policy events. No minimum generation length is forced.

free_generation.repetition: token repeated 4/8-gram fraction, longest same-token run, repeated suffix; descriptive human-review aids
free_generation.review_flag: at least 32 output tokens and repeated 4-gram ratio > 0.5

comparison: same local model, prompts, samples, task definitions and seeds; per-arm natural trajectories and cohort sizes may differ
limit: Explicit --limit is exploratory. Task limits are per leaf, including each MMLU subject. Free generation default is 200 distinct prompts.
resources: Main session owns GPU scheduling. prepare is CPU-only, pins four official dataset repository commit hashes and stops further downloading if dataset directory exceeds 2 GiB.
